book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第四册
unit_cn: Unit 4 Business Blossoms 商业绽放
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第四册 Unit 4 词表(p38-47 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、创业/经济/财务主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Before her speech, Zhang Yue wiped the sweat from her forehead.
words.example_cn: 演讲前,张悦擦去额头上的汗。

words.meaning_cn: 无表情的,茫然的;空白的
words.example_en: The investors stared back with blank faces, giving no clue what they thought.
words.example_cn: 投资人面无表情地回望,让人猜不透他们的想法。

words.example_en: Feeling dizzy with fear, she took a deep breath and finished her business plan.
words.example_cn: 因恐惧而头晕的她深吸一口气,讲完了商业计划。

words.example_en: She is now the chairwoman of her own rose company.
words.example_cn: 她如今是自己玫瑰公司的女会长。

words.example_en: The workers pick the delicate flowers before sunrise.
words.example_cn: 工人们在日出前采摘娇嫩的花朵。

words.example_en: Only after returning home did she realise the business potential of roses.
words.example_cn: 直到回到家乡,她才意识到玫瑰的商业潜力。

words.example_en: Like many young people, she was bitten by the start-up bug.
words.example_cn: 和许多年轻人一样,她迷上了创业。

words.meaning_cn: 有创业精神的,有进取心的
words.example_en: More enterprising young people are thinking of starting their own businesses.
words.example_cn: 越来越多有创业精神的年轻人想自己创业。

words.example_en: Experienced business people gave her important input and support.
words.example_cn: 经验丰富的商人给了她重要的投入和支持。

words.example_en: She has overcome a number of obstacles to make her business succeed.
words.example_cn: 她克服了许多障碍,使生意取得成功。

words.example_en: The biggest challenge at the initial phase was hiring workers.
words.example_cn: 起步阶段最大的挑战是雇人。

words.example_en: A major manufacturer of cosmetics offered to buy her product.
words.example_cn: 一家大型化妆品制造商提出购买她的产品。

words.example_en: The company uses her roses to make expensive cosmetics.
words.example_cn: 这家公司用她的玫瑰制作昂贵的化妆品。

words.example_en: The manufacturer was willing to purchase her product and help sell it.
words.example_cn: 制造商愿意购买她的产品并帮忙销售。

words.example_en: A big partner helped her with the distribution of the roses.
words.example_cn: 一个大合作伙伴帮她做玫瑰的分销。

words.example_en: This year she can pay every worker a decent bonus.
words.example_cn: 今年她能给每位工人发一笔可观的奖金。

words.example_en: She welcomes the new entrepreneurial spirit among young people.
words.example_cn: 她欢迎年轻人中新兴的创业精神。

words.example_en: She advises young people to seek guidance from experts first.
words.example_cn: 她建议年轻人先向专家寻求指导。

words.example_en: Before starting out, ask an experienced consultant for advice.
words.example_cn: 在起步之前,向有经验的顾问请教。

words.example_en: Fair-trade prices are higher than under the conventional trading system.
words.example_cn: 公平贸易的价格高于传统贸易体系下的价格。

words.example_en: Some argue that the system discriminates against producers outside it.
words.example_cn: 有人认为这一制度歧视体系外的生产者。

words.example_en: The coffee is grown on an estate close to the equator.
words.example_cn: 这种咖啡产于赤道附近的庄园。

words.example_en: The beans are grown on the Green Equator Estate.
words.example_cn: 咖啡豆产于绿赤道庄园。

words.example_en: Customers love the superior, smooth flavour of the product.
words.example_cn: 顾客喜爱这款产品上乘而顺滑的口感。

words.example_en: The coffee has a smooth blend with a mild flavour.
words.example_cn: 这款咖啡口感顺滑,味道不浓烈。

words.example_en: Each cup contains less than one calorie.
words.example_cn: 每杯所含热量不到一卡路里。

words.example_en: In the past, lenders relied mainly on their subjective judgement.
words.example_cn: 过去,放贷者主要依靠自己的主观判断。

words.example_en: As a freshman, you must handle your own money for the first time.
words.example_cn: 作为大一新生,你要第一次自己管理钱。

words.meaning_cn: 不欠债的,经济上周转得开的
words.example_en: Here are some tips to help students stay afloat.
words.example_cn: 这里有一些帮助学生不欠债的建议。

words.example_en: Make sure a part-time job does not interfere with your studies.
words.example_cn: 确保兼职工作不妨碍你的学业。

words.example_en: Always make rational spending choices and avoid luxuries.
words.example_cn: 始终做出理性的消费选择,避免奢侈品。

words.example_en: Never exceed your agreed credit limit.
words.example_cn: 切勿超出你约定的信用额度。

words.example_en: Good financial management is a useful skill for life.
words.example_cn: 良好的财务管理是一项终身受用的技能。

words.example_en: Save a little each week, and your money will accumulate over time.
words.example_cn: 每周存一点,你的钱会随时间积累起来。

words.example_en: Annual fees are charged automatically to your credit card.
words.example_cn: 年费会自动从你的信用卡扣除。

words.example_en: Since we were toddlers, we have been told that it is good to share.
words.example_cn: 从蹒跚学步起,我们就被告知分享是好事。

words.example_en: We share toys, snacks and sometimes even sorrow with others.
words.example_cn: 我们与他人分享玩具、零食,有时甚至分享悲伤。

words.example_en: Sharing is not just about sweets; it can also ease our frustration.
words.example_cn: 分享不只是关于糖果,它也能缓解我们的沮丧。

words.example_en: With a phone you can hire a bike for the whole afternoon.
words.example_cn: 用手机你可以租一辆自行车骑一下午。

words.example_en: Sharing encourages people to reuse items, thereby cutting down on waste.
words.example_cn: 分享鼓励人们重复使用物品,由此减少浪费。

words.example_en: The sharing economy grows faster than existing rules or supervision.
words.example_cn: 共享经济的发展快于现有规则或监管。

words.example_en: Some firms expand at the expense of more traditional companies.
words.example_cn: 一些公司以损害传统企业为代价来扩张。

words.example_en: The sharing economy is sometimes subject to abuse of trust.
words.example_cn: 共享经济有时会遭遇信任的滥用。

words.example_en: Some users have become victims of theft while sharing rides.
words.example_cn: 一些用户在拼车时成了盗窃的受害者。

words.example_en: With phone payment, you never worry about losing your purse.
words.example_cn: 用手机支付,你再也不必担心丢钱包。
